subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path request for SatelliteConnect connector
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@satelliteconnect.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Satellite Connect Finance <finance@satelliteconnect.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path request for SatelliteConnect connector

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the connector looks promising and our product team is ready to run a 6-week pilot with a small batch of customers. We're onboarding through partners this quarter and want to move quickly. Two asks from our side:

1) We need to complete your vendor onboarding form and share our SOC2 report (attached).
2) For the pilot only, can Redwood accept invoices without a purchase order (invoice-only) for up to $10k/month? Our procurement is slower than our product timeline and we usually do invoice-only for early integrations.

I attached: Satellite_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf and SOC2-SAT-2026.pdf.

If invoice-only is possible, we can route invoices to finance@satelliteconnect.com and we will sign an SOW that references a later PO when your procurement completes. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Appreciate it —
Amy Chen
Head of Partnerships
Satellite Connect
[attachment: Satellite_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]
[attachment: SOC2-SAT-2026.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@satelliteconnect.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path request for SatelliteConnect connector

Thanks Amy — appreciate the quick follow-up and for sending the form + SOC2. I reviewed the attachments and looped in Priyom (finance ops) and Lauren (legal ops) to help route this.

Quick context: our standard policy requires a PO for vendor invoices, but we do grant short-term invoice-only exceptions for low-dollar pilots with controls. Priyom — can you weigh in on whether we can approve an invoice-only onboarding for SC under a temporary exception? My ask is that if we allow it, we include a clear transition plan to a PO within 60–90 days, a signed SOW, and a hard monthly cap (proposed $10k).

Amy — noted that invoices will go to finance@satelliteconnect.com. If possible, could you add the SOW draft to the onboarding form or share a link? Also please confirm the expected billing cadence (monthly? milestone-based?).

Next steps I propose:
- Priyom to evaluate payment risk and confirm approval conditions.
- If approved, Lauren will draft an exception memo we keep on file and an acceptance email for the customer.
- Karthik will coordinate technical onboarding and schedule the kickoff.

Will keep this short and get back today/tomorrow.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[karthik@redwood.ai]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-06T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path request for SatelliteConnect connector

Monica — forwarding a request from Satellite Connect (deal SC-2027-PILOT-3321). Karthik and I discussed; they want a temporary invoice-only onboarding for a 6-week pilot. Attachments from the vendor are included.

Summary / proposed guardrails:
- Duration: up to 90 days from onboarding approval.
- Monthly cap: $10,000 gross invoiced amount.
- Required docs before approval: completed vendor onboarding form, SOC2 on file, signed SOW referencing the pilot scope.
- Transition: vendor must provide PO within 90 days; if no PO received, Redwood reserves the right to halt provisioning and withhold further invoices.
- Billing: monthly invoices to finance@satelliteconnect.com; invoices must reference deal id SC-2027-PILOT-3321.

Risk notes: Satellite Connect is a small partner but has a usable SOC2; exposure capped by the $10k monthly limit. I recommend approving with the above conditions and a single finance contact on the invoice distribution list. If Procurement approves, Lauren can draft the exception memo for our records.

Please advise approval or required changes.

Attachments: Satellite_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf, SOC2-SAT-2026.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@satelliteconnect.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Satellite Connect Finance <finance@satelliteconnect.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only path request for SatelliteConnect connector

Priyom / Karthik — after reviewing the onboarding form and SOC2, Procurement approves a one-time, temporary invoice-only onboarding for Satellite Connect under the following conditions:

1) Approval window: 90 days from date of this approval (until 2027-07-06).
2) Cap: invoices may not exceed $10,000 per calendar month.
3) Required paperwork: signed SOW referencing the pilot and the Redwood deal id SC-2027-PILOT-3321; onboarding form and SOC2 must remain on file.
4) PO transition: Satellite Connect must provide a valid purchase order within 90 days. If a PO is not received by 2027-07-06, Redwood may suspend provisioning and pause payments for subsequent invoices.
5) Invoicing instructions: invoices should be addressed to Redwood Inference, Attn: Finance, reference SC-2027-PILOT-3321, and be sent to finance@satelliteconnect.com (cc: finance-ops@redwood.ai).

Amy — please reply to confirm you accept these terms and share the signed SOW when ready. Lauren will prepare a short exception memo that we'll store in procurement records; copy will be sent to your finance contact.

I'll also add a single-point escalation: if billing issues appear, route to finance-ops@redwood.ai and Procurement (monica_patel@redwood.ai).

Approved by:
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
